title: Create src/templates/webapp/ directory structure
description: Create the skeleton directory structure for the webapp (React + Express) project template. This is the container — actual template files will be added in subsequent tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Directory structure is committed to git (add .gitkeep files to empty dirs)

steps.description: Create the webapp template directory tree
steps.details: Create the following directory structure: src/templates/webapp/, src/templates/webapp/client/, src/templates/webapp/client/src/, src/templates/webapp/server/, src/templates/webapp/server/src/

Git does not track empty directories. Add empty .gitkeep files to any directories that don't yet have files: touch src/templates/webapp/client/.gitkeep, src/templates/webapp/server/.gitkeep if needed.
Run `find src/templates/webapp -type d` and confirm client/ and server/ subdirectories exist.

technicalNotes: Template files use {{PLACEHOLDER}} syntax for variable substitution (handled by template-engine.ts, TASK-36)
Binary files in templates (images, fonts) will be copied without token replacement
